dina (eng-security): heads up - noticed a gap in SCIM deprovision events for tenant helios after last KMS rewrap. RBAC entries show role removed but users still have entitlements. audit logs show nothing between 12:02 and 12:07 UTC. anyone else seeing this?
vikram (infra): seeing the alert too. queue shows successful PATCH to scim endpoint but scim-bot returned 204 with empty body. hooking into logs now.
olivia (idp): okta side shows a spike of 502 proxies around 12:03. confirm: did we swap KMS alias at ~12:01?
vikram (infra): we rotated alias as part of emergency rewrap at 11:59 - that completed successfully per KMS job. no other infra changes.
scim-bot: automated: deprov_job: helios: users=12, request_id=Z3HJ-77, start=2026-03-23T12:02:10Z, result=204, response_time_ms=120
dina (eng-security): logs snippet from provisioning service (redacted):
```
2026-03-23T12:02:11Z INFO handler.patch user=svc-hel-provision request_id=Z3HJ-77 body={"active":false}
2026-03-23T12:02:11Z ERROR audit: failed to emit event: PutObjectAccessDenied: Access Denied
2026-03-23T12:02:12Z INFO handler.completed request_id=Z3HJ-77 status=204
```
vikram (infra): that PutObjectAccessDenied looks like a KMS/permissions thing when writing audit blobs to S3. during rewrap we briefly updated the service role's encryption context and a Lambda that signs audit payloads couldn't use new key policy.
olivia (idp): that would mean provisioning proceeded (Okta accepted PATCH), but our platform never recorded the audit event. RBAC change recorded in db though?
dina (eng-security): database shows role mapping removed at 12:02:11, but downstream entitlement sync job (which relies on audit logs for replay) didn't run because it had no audit ID. so entitlements stayed.
vikram (infra): immediate mitigation: i) roll KMS alias back to previous key to restore signing job permissions ii) re-run audit re-emit for the window using stored changejournal iii) enqueue deprov replay for affected users. I'll start rollback now.
oncall-bot: incident triggered: INC-2026-342 created by vikram - severity P2. Notifying oncall.
scim-bot: queued replay for helios users (12) request_id=Z3HJ-77-replay, eta=2m
dina (eng-security): quick checks after rollback: can someone verify audit writer can PutObject again and that newly emitted events contain the expected audit_id?
vikram (infra): rollback complete at 12:08:04. I see PutObject OKs now. re-emit job started; output: audit_emitter: reemit window=12:02:00-12:07:00 emitted=11 events, missing=1 (user svc-hel-provision slow).
olivia (idp): reapply replayed deprovs; Okta patch idempotent so replay should be safe. I'll validate entitlements cleared.
dina (eng-security): after replay entitlements for the 12 users show removed in both DB and Okta. marking as mitigated.
vikram (infra): action items: 1) add a KMS key policy test into the rewrap playbook to validate PutObject with audit role before cutover 2) add fallback to buffer audit events locally if PutObject fails, with exponential backoff and an alert when >30s backlog 3) ticket ops: I pushed INC-2026-342 and created a follow-up RFC to change rewrap procedure.
dina (eng-security): agree. also let's add an eval in Redwood Optimize to flag divergence between RBAC DB state and entitlement sync results - would catch this class earlier.
olivia (idp): cc:security-compliance for audit trail. I'll write a short postmortem draft and link to INC-2026-342.
vikram (infra): tagging owners: @olivia for idp replay validation, @dina for postmortem, infra to own rewrap playbook.
dina (eng-security): thanks all. remaining TODOs: add unit test for audit emitter to simulate KMS policy mismatch, schedule runbook training. closing thread after postmortem link posted. :white_check_mark:
